subject: Integration workshop at Redwood HQ — room booking, NDA, and shuttle coordination
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@integron.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@integron.com
Date: Mon, 10 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite integration workshop at Redwood HQ — date options and NDA

Hi Tessa,

Hope you	're well. We're excited to run a one-day integration workshop at Redwood HQ to validate the routing and auth flow before we flip it into staging. High-level ask: 4-6 engineers + 1 engineering manager, 1 solutions lead. Would like access to a conference room with AV and breakout space for pair work.

Preferred dates from our side:
- Tue Apr 19 (all day)
- Thu Apr 21 (morning only)
- Fri Apr 22

Two quick questions:
1) Do we need an NDA in advance of the visit, and can we sign electronically?
2) Is there a shuttle or recommended hotel for the team arriving from SFO?

If you can propose a confirmed date/time and push the DocuSign NDA, we'll get internal approvals.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Head of Integrations, Integron Systems
ops@integron.com
[Attachment: team_headcount.csv (text/csv)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Li <sarah.li@integron.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite integration workshop at Redwood HQ — date options and NDA

Hi Sarah,

Great — we'd love to host Integron for the integration day. Thanks for the date options. Two quick items on our side: room and security.

We can accommodate the team on Friday Apr 22 (recommended) or Tue Apr 19 (we have partial theater use that morning). Would you prefer an all-day run on Apr 22? If Apr 19 is necessary we can make the afternoon work but we	d need to confirm AV load-in by 10:00 AM.

NDA: I pushed the standard visitor NDA to DocuSign this morning. Link below. Please sign and send the HubSpot record # so we can match the signature.

Shuttle/Hotel: We recommend the Redwood Guest Shuttle (from SFO) which can pick up at 08:30 or 11:30. If you prefer hotels, the Cardinal Inn is ~8 min away.

I've attached an initial room availability sheet and our visitor policy. Mateo (Facilities) is looped to confirm room setup and security escort. Jordan, can you confirm whether Integron is eligible for the integration discount under D-4821 and if we should prepare an MSA amendment?

DocuSign NDA: https://app.docusign.com/documents/ABC-123-Integron-NDA
Attachments: hq-room-availability.xlsx, visitor-policy.pdf

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Program Manager, Customer Onboarding
Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0147
[Attachment: hq-room-availability.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Apr 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite integration workshop at Redwood HQ — room and AV constraints

Tessa / Jordan,

Quick ops note after checking floor bookings:
- Apr 19: Main demo theater is booked until 13:30 for an external lunch event. We could do load-in after 13:45 but the theater sound system will be in use until 14:15.
- Apr 22: We have Suite B (four small breakout tables + 1 AV wall) available all day.

Recommendation: Confirm Apr 22 (all day) to avoid theater transition risk. If Integron needs Apr 19 AM I can request early AV crew at extra cost (estimate $420).

Security/badging: For groups >5, we require a list of attendees and driver license numbers for day-badges (policy attached). Escort available.

AV contact: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.com) — he can bring the HDMI switch and spare adaptors.

I'll tentatively reserve Suite B for Apr 22 pending signed NDA and final headcount.

-Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Facilities & Events Coordinator
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: integration-runbook-v1.2.docx]

From: Sarah Li <sarah.li@integron.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: ops@integron.com
Date: Fri, 20 Apr 2028 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite integration workshop at Redwood HQ — room booking, NDA, and shuttle coordination

Tessa,

Thanks for the quick coordination. We've signed the DocuSign NDA (signed 2028-04-18) and uploaded the completed form to the Drive link you provided. Confirming the team will come on Fri Apr 22 (all day) — final headcount: 6 engineers, 1 engineering manager, 1 solutions lead.

Could you confirm:
- Arrival time: We	d like to be picked up by the 08:30 shuttle at SFO.
- Badge pickup: Who will meet the team and where should they go on arrival?

Also, can you confirm whether the Suite B layout will include two projection displays (one at each end) and a whiteboard? We may need two HDMI cables and one USB-C adapter.

Thanks again. Looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Sarah
